email.subject: Expedite: Montréal to Boston, 2150 KG
email.body:
Bonjour,

Small load, need it moved fast. Pickup tomorrow (Tuesday) 9h at Optique Laurentides, 3400 boul. Industriel, Montréal QC H1H 2X6. Deliver Wednesday Nov 18 to Beacon Eyewear, 25 Drydock Ave, Boston MA 02210, before noon.

6 skids ophthalmic lenses, 2150 KG. Ref OL-2026-118. Straight truck or cargo van is fine.

Your quote please.

Hélène Roy
Optique Laurentides
